rules.percentile: Each indicator is ranked against its own trailing history (5 years for daily series, 20 years for slower ones, all available history for AI series) using only data public on each day; revised macro series are ranked within each data vintage.
rules.orientation: Ranks are oriented so 100 means greed (G1, G3) or healthy (G2, G4).
rules.staleness: An input's weight is full until it is 1.5x its expected age since publication, then falls linearly to zero at 3x.
rules.events: Manual entries carry status weights: primary 1.0, guidance 0.8, secondhand 0.6, estimate 0.3.
rules.composite: Pillar = weighted mean of live indicators; gauge = weighted mean of live pillars, renormalized for missing weight. Coverage is the live share of target weight; below 70% the needle is hatched.
rules.display: G1-G3 needles use a 3-day EMA; G4 is unsmoothed.
rules.validation: Phase 3 backtest demoted indicators whose sign was wrong or unstable across stress regimes; see reports/validation.md.
